headline: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
summary: Google's 4K streaming box price increased by $50. The device now retails for $149, up from its original $99. New pricing is live at the Google Store and Best Buy.

headline: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
summary: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max Google TV projector is now available globally. It features a new dual-iris system for an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast. The projector is designed to be ideal for gamers and sports enthusiasts.

headline: FTC lawsuit alleges Amazon has been ‘secretly and systematically’ overcharging for ads
summary: The FTC and 22 states are suing Amazon over alleged 'secret ad surcharge.' The lawsuit claims Amazon inflated ad prices on its platform. These higher costs were reportedly passed on to American consumers.

headline: I went to the loneliest baseball game on Apple Vision Pro
summary: A user watched a baseball game in immersive virtual reality using Apple Vision Pro. The experience was technically impressive and visually remarkable. Despite the advanced tech, the immersive viewing 'didn't make that much sense.'

headline: Duane Davis Found Guilty in Murder of Tupac Shakur
summary: Duane Davis was found guilty in the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur. The verdict arrives nearly 30 years after the Las Vegas drive-by shooting. This conviction brings closure to a decades-old mystery.

headline: Labor Day Sales Are Now Live — Here's Where You Can Find Deals Today
summary: Labor Day sales events are currently underway. Shoppers can find various deals and discounts across multiple retailers. Discover the best holiday sales available today.

headline: Save 70% Off Proton VPN's 2-Year Plan, Now Just $2.99
summary: Proton VPN is offering a 70% discount on its 2-year subscription. Get a top-rated VPN service for only $2.99 per month. This limited-time deal makes premium online security highly affordable.

headline: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Is Better Than Its 2026 Successor, and It's on Sale for Labor Day
summary: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is currently available at a discounted price for Labor Day. This model is considered superior to its upcoming 2026 successor. It's the last in its lineup to feature QD-OLED technology.

headline: Ex-Crips leader found guilty in 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
summary: An ex-Crips gang leader has been found guilty in the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur. The verdict concludes decades of mystery surrounding the rapper's death. This conviction brings closure to the long-unsolved case.

headline: Shein shares slide in long-awaited stock market debut
summary: Shein's shares experienced a slide during its stock market debut in Hong Kong. The listing follows years of attempts to float shares in New York and London. The firm faced a challenging start to its public trading.

headline: Burnham to face Parliament as prime minister for first time
summary: Burnham is set to address Parliament for the first time as Prime Minister. This session marks a critical point, potentially ending his 'honeymoon period.' It signifies the beginning of significant legislative challenges for the new PM.

headline: US army secretary resigns after months of tension
summary: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned after approximately 18 months in his post. His resignation follows months of underlying tension. Driscoll was notably the youngest-ever individual to hold the army secretary position.
